title: Observe USA shop wheel pagination and early recognition
platforms: Linux interpreter, USA fork core; GUI untested
changes: Compare wheel pagination against a control in the catalogued USA shop and record an initial early-input failure.
validation: After 40 neutral frames from list recognition, six down and six up requests traversed and returned across a 7-item/4-visible list while control stayed at 0; ROM and checkpoint hashes unchanged.
limitations: At first recognition the first request did not move and the six-step assertion failed; cause unproven and evidence retained. No GUI, native, replay, other categories or upstream USA scrollbar was tested.
Managed cleanup rejects non-rom-data U31 directories; both failed and successful units remain.
